title: The Birth of Jesus and His Childhood

questions.question: Who issued a decree that all the world should be registered (a census)?
options: Caesar Augustus
Herod the Great
Tiberius Caesar
Pontius Pilate
questions.explanation: Luke 2:1 (ESV): "In those days a decree went out from Caesar Augustus that all the world should be registered."

questions.question: Why did Joseph go from Nazareth in Galilee to Bethlehem in Judea for the census?
options: Because he was of the house and lineage of David
Because he owned property in Bethlehem
Because the Angel Gabriel told him to travel there
Because Mary wanted to give birth near Jerusalem
questions.correctAnswer: Because he was of the house and lineage of David
questions.explanation: Luke 2:4 (ESV): "And Joseph also went up from Galilee... to the city of David, which is called Bethlehem, because he was of the house and lineage of David,"

questions.question: After Mary gave birth to her firstborn son, she wrapped him in swaddling cloths and laid him in a manger. Why?
options: Because there was no place for them in the inn
Because the angels commanded it to be so
Because Joseph was a poor carpenter with no money
Because it fulfilled a specific prophecy of Micah
questions.correctAnswer: Because there was no place for them in the inn
questions.explanation: Luke 2:7 (ESV): "And she gave birth to her firstborn son and wrapped him in swaddling cloths and laid him in a manger, because there was no place for them in the inn."

questions.question: Who were out in the field, keeping watch over their flock by night, when an angel of the Lord appeared to them?
options: Shepherds
Magi from the East
Roman soldiers
Priests off-duty
questions.explanation: Luke 2:8 (ESV): "And in the same region there were shepherds out in the field, keeping watch over their flock by night."

questions.question: What did the multitude of the heavenly host say as they praised God?
options: "Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace among those with whom he is pleased!"
"Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God Almighty!"
"Hosanna in the highest! Blessed is the newborn King!"
"Worthy is the Lamb who was born to save the world!"
questions.correctAnswer: "Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace among those with whom he is pleased!"
questions.explanation: Luke 2:14 (ESV): "Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace among those with whom he is pleased!"

questions.question: What did Mary do after the shepherds came and told what had been spoken to them about the child?
options: She treasured up all these things, pondering them in her heart
She wrote them down in a scroll
She proudly proclaimed them to all in Bethlehem
She wept out of fear of King Herod
questions.correctAnswer: She treasured up all these things, pondering them in her heart
questions.explanation: Luke 2:19 (ESV): "But Mary treasured up all these things, pondering them in her heart."

questions.question: Who was the righteous and devout man in Jerusalem to whom it was revealed that he would not see death before he had seen the Lord's Christ?
options: Simeon
Zechariah
Nicodemus
Barnabas
questions.explanation: Luke 2:25-26 (ESV): "Now there was a man in Jerusalem, whose name was Simeon... And it had been revealed to him by the Holy Spirit that he would not see death before he had seen the Lord's Christ."

questions.question: When Simeon took the baby Jesus in his arms, he blessed God and said, "Lord, now you are letting your servant depart in peace." What is this prayer traditionally called?
options: The Nunc Dimittis
The Magnificat
The Benedictus
The Ave Maria
questions.explanation: Luke 2:29 (ESV): "Lord, now you are letting your servant depart in peace, according to your word;" (Known as the Nunc dimittis, from its Latin opening).

questions.question: Simeon told Mary that this child is appointed for the fall and rising of many in Israel, and also told her what would happen to her own soul?
options: "And a sword will pierce through your own soul also"
"And joy will overflow your cup daily"
"And you will be queens among women"
"And sorrow will be far from your tent"
questions.correctAnswer: "And a sword will pierce through your own soul also"
questions.explanation: Luke 2:35 (ESV): "(and a sword will pierce through your own soul also), so that thoughts from many hearts may be revealed."

questions.question: Who was the prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher, who did not depart from the temple but worshipped with fasting and prayer night and day?
options: Anna
Elizabeth
Hannah
Miriam
questions.explanation: Luke 2:36-37 (ESV): "And there was a prophetess, Anna, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher... She did not depart from the temple, worshiping with fasting and prayer night and day."

questions.question: How old was Jesus when His parents took Him to Jerusalem for the Feast of the Passover, where He stayed behind?
options: Twelve years old
Ten years old
Fourteen years old
Seven years old
questions.explanation: Luke 2:42 (ESV): "And when he was twelve years old, they went up according to custom."

questions.question: How many days did Joseph and Mary search before they found Jesus in the temple?
options: Three days
One day
Seven days
Two days
questions.explanation: Luke 2:46 (ESV): "After three days they found him in the temple, sitting among the teachers, listening to them and asking them questions."

questions.question: What was Jesus doing when His parents found Him in the temple?
options: Sitting among the teachers, listening to them and asking them questions
Preaching to a large crowd
Reading from the scroll of Isaiah
Cleaning the altar of incense
questions.correctAnswer: Sitting among the teachers, listening to them and asking them questions
questions.explanation: Luke 2:46 (ESV): "...they found him in the temple, sitting among the teachers, listening to them and asking them questions."

questions.question: When Mary asked, "Son, why have you treated us so? Behold, your father and I have been searching for you in great distress," what was Jesus' reply?
options: "Why were you looking for me? Did you not know that I must be in my Father's house?"
"I was doing the will of the Lord."
"The Spirit guided me to stay and learn."
"I am safe, Mother, do not weep."
questions.correctAnswer: "Why were you looking for me? Did you not know that I must be in my Father's house?"
questions.explanation: Luke 2:49 (ESV): "And he said to them, 'Why were you looking for me? Did you not know that I must be in my Father's house?'"

questions.question: How does Luke summarize Jesus' childhood and growth after returning to Nazareth?
options: And Jesus increased in wisdom and in stature and in favor with God and man
And he worked as a carpenter until he was thirty
And he studied the Torah night and day
And he remained silent until the time of his ministry
questions.correctAnswer: And Jesus increased in wisdom and in stature and in favor with God and man
questions.explanation: Luke 2:52 (ESV): "And Jesus increased in wisdom and in stature and in favor with God and man."

key_verse_text: "For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Savior, who is Christ the Lord."
